definitions.gloss: docking; coming alongside a pier; berthing
definitions.explanation: The act of a ship arriving at and mooring alongside a wharf or pier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{着岸|ちゃくがん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦フェリー→フェリー：11168_ferii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{着岸|ちゃくがん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦{客船|きゃくせん}→客船：16792_kyakusen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{着岸|ちゃくがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: Due to strong winds, the docking of the large cruise ship is delayed.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (to arrive) + {岸|がん} (shore, bank). A nautical term describing the moment a ship reaches and secures itself to a pier or wharf. The opposite is {離岸|りがん} (leaving the pier, casting off).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着岸|ちゃくがん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to dock, to berth
- {着岸|ちゃくがん}⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧ — scheduled docking time
- {着岸|ちゃくがん}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ — docking operations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{接岸|せつがん}→接岸：24377_setsugan⟧ — coming alongside a pier; very close synonym, slightly more technical
- ⟦{入港|にゅうこう}→入港：14771_nyuukou⟧ — entering a port; broader, refers to arriving in the harbor area
- {離岸|りがん} — leaving the pier; the opposite action
